mentions.name: Maylo
mentions.description: A Chrome text-to-speech and reading tools extension designed to make written online content accessible to dyslexic readers. It supports Google Docs, PDFs, and the web, and aims to stay out of the way while offering better tracking, better voices, and lower cost than existing options. Writing support is planned next.
mentions.problem: Dyslexic readers struggle to access written content online and at school; existing text-to-speech extensions are intrusive, costly, and lack good tracking and voices.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built a Chrome text-to-speech and reading tools extension to make it easier for him to get access to written content online (and also to support him at school). It has support for Google Docs and PDFs as well as the web. There are a few of these, but this one tries to stay out of the way, have better tracking, better voices and lower cost.
